variants.hypothesis: The agent is confused about when to use route_to_spring_hill vs transfer_call and is calling get_availability before asking reason for visit because the gating rule is buried in the Tool Use Rules section instead of being frontloaded in the path flow.

The agent is treating procedural steps as optional suggestions rather than mandatory gates, so explicitly labeling critical steps as REQUIRED and placing them as numbered checklists at the start of each path will enforce compliance.
